headline: Sales tax is computed on the discounted price, so a discounted order is no longer over-taxed
summary: Checkout calculated sales tax on the full pre-discount subtotal even though the tax primitive's documented contract is to receive the post-discount subtotal (lib/tax.js: "Tax is computed against subtotal_minor (post-discount, pre-shipping)"). So every order carrying an automatic discount or a coupon was taxed on merchandise value the customer didn't pay for, over-collecting tax and overstating the order total. The tax base is now the subtotal minus the discount, computed by resolving the discount before the tax call. Shipping rates still gate on the pre-discount merchandise value — a free-shipping threshold is earned on what's in the cart, not the post-discount total — and an order with no discount is unaffected. No migration to apply.

items.title: A discounted order is taxed on the price actually paid
items.body: Sales tax now applies to the post-discount subtotal: the automatic-discount and coupon reduction is resolved first and subtracted from the taxable base before tax is calculated. Previously tax was computed on the full pre-discount subtotal, so a discounted or couponed order was over-taxed and its total overstated by the tax on the discounted-away amount. An order with no discount sees no change, and free-shipping thresholds continue to be evaluated against the pre-discount merchandise value.
